doc.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Helen Merrill session at Riverside
summary: Laws recalls a Helen Merrill session at the Riverside studios and Mongo's last records there.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Because I’m thinking of Gato [Barbieri]. He had that thing. John Lewis and Helen Merrill? Any recollection about that one?

I remember Helen Merrill. I remember we recorded up in Riverside – what used to be Riverside recording studios. That’s where Orrin used to be also. I recorded up there with Mongo. Mongo did one of his last records up there at Riverside, along with Nat Adderley playing trumpet on a tune that I wrote called Bembe Blue.
